question.problem:
Which of the following integers belong to the residue class $[7]_{11}?$

- $18$
- $-4$
- $15$
question.worked_solution:
The residue class $[7]_{11}$ consists of the elements that are congruent to $7$ modulo $11.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[7]_{11} & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡7\,(\text{mod}\,11)} \\  & ={x\in Z\,|\,x=7+11k,\,k\in Z} \\  & ={7+11k\,|\,k\in Z} \\  & ={…,\,7-2\cdot 11,\,7-11,\,7,\,7+11,\,7+2\cdot 11,…} \\  & ={…,-15,-4,7,18,29,…}.\end{aligned}
$$

We see that $-4$ and $18$ belong to $[7]_{11},$ while $15$ does not.

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and II only".
